newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela investment tax break seen okayed Friday.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela investment tax break seen okayed Friday.

text.p: Venezuela's Tax Superintendecny expects a key tax law that exempts companies from paying a 16.5 percent levy on the start-up costs of capital intensive projects in key sectors such as oil to be approved this Friday by the cabinet of economic ministers.
Seniat president Edgar Paredes Pisani said "this new ruling should help stimulate foreign investment ... although it comes at a fiscal cost".

Although the tax exemption was approved by congress in July, the enabling mechanism that supported it was not. Delays left planned multi-billion dollar oil and mining investments hanging, according to industry sources.
